title: Topic 15: Classroom & Learning - Vocabulary
description: Core words for classroom & learning: book, pen, paper, question, answer, word, read, listen. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Use classroom language - instructions, asking about spelling and meaning
introductionText:
book = you read it (open your book!)
pen = you write with it  |  paper = you write on it
question = Where...? What...? -> ?
answer = your response to a question
word = hello is a word!  |  read = eyes on the words
listen = ears on! (listen to the audio)
+ phrase bank: How do you spell...? |
What does ... mean? | Sorry, can you repeat, please?
+ grammar note: Open IT (the book). Read THEM (the
words). Help ME!

explanations.A1-T15-VOC-Q1: Pen -> you write WITH it. Paper -> you write ON it.
explanations.A1-T15-VOC-Q6: New word? Ask: How do you spell it? (chunk - learn it whole!)
explanations.A1-T15-VOC-Q7: The book = IT. The words (many) = THEM.
explanations.A1-T15-VOC-Q8: Help ME (not help I!). I -> me after a verb.
